content.text: Here is a comprehensive analysis of the **Dynamic Tier List** project at `E:\kaifa\dynamic-tier-list-fork\dynamic-tier-list-fork`. --- ## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW This is a **browser-based, client-side tier list builder** built with **React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS**. It allows users (primarily content creators/streamers) to rapidly build visual tier lists by drag-and-dropping or copy-pasting images into tier rows. Everything runs entirely in the browser -- there is no backend. All data (images, tiers, settings) is stored locally in **IndexedDB** and **localStorage**. The app is deployed via GitHub Pages. The README (which appears to be from a fork) notes: "Added pagination functionality" (in Chinese: "添加分页功能"). --- ## 2. BUILD CONFIGURATION ### package.json - **Framework**: React 18.2 via Create React App (`react-scripts 5.0.1`) - **Key runtime dependencies**: - `react-sortablejs` + `sortablejs` -- drag-and-drop reordering within and between tiers (the core UX primitive) - `react-color` -- `SketchPicker` color picker for tier colors - `exceljs` -- XLSX spreadsheet export - `html-to-image` -- captures the tier list DOM node as a PNG blob (for copy/save) - `jszip` -- ZIP export of full-resolution images with manifest - **Dev dependencies**: Tailwind CSS 3.3, ESLint - **Scripts**: standard CRA (`start`, `build`, `test`, `eject`) plus `lint`/`lint:fix` - **Linting**: tab indentation enforced, standard CRA rules - **Homepage**: `"."` (relative path, used for GitHub Pages) ### tsconfig.json - Target: ES5, JSX: `react-jsx`, strict mode enabled - Module resolution: Node, isolated modules, no emit (CRA handles build) ### tailwind.config.js - Minimal: scans `./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}`, no custom theme extensions, no plugins --- ## 3. ARCHITECTURE & COMPONENT TREE ``` App (root) |-- ProjectContext.Provider |-- StylingContext.Provider |-- TierContext.Provider |-- ProjectSelector (top: project dropdown, CRUD) |-- TierList (middle: sortable list of Tier rows) | |-- Tier (x N) (each row: colored label + sortable images) | |-- Image (x N) (individual image with context menu) |-- AddTierButton (button + TierModal for adding tiers) |-- ImageHolder (bottom "inbox": unassigned images) | |-- Image (x N) | |-- SettingsModal (gear icon opens settings) ``` ### Three React Contexts 1. **ProjectContext** -- provides `{ projectId, namespace, switchProject }`. The `namespace` is the key prefix (`project__`) used for localStorage and IndexedDB isolation. 2. **StylingContext** -- provides `{ style, setStyle }` with `Style` typed as `{ ratio, size, quality, pasteScaleMode }`. 3. **TierContext** -- provides `{ tiers, setTiers }` with `Tier` typed as `{ id, color, tierLabel }`. ### Key architectural pattern: `App` vs `AppInner` `App` is the initializing wrapper. On mount it: 1. Checks if a project system already exists (via `getProjectList()`) 2. If first-time (no projects): migrates old un-namespaced localStorage keys and IndexedDB data into a "Default" project with namespace `project_default_` 3. Resolves the current project ID and sets `appState` 4. Renders `` -- the `key` prop **forces a full re-mount** when switching projects, cleanly resetting all state `AppInner` initializes tiers and style from the namespaced localStorage, then renders the full component tree inside the three context providers. --- ## 4. DATA MODELS ### Tier (`src/App.tsx`) ```typescript interface Tier { id: number; // unique ID (Date.now() for new, opaque for defaults) color: string; // hex color for the tier label background tierLabel: string; // e.g., "S", "A", "B", "C", "D" } ``` Defaults: 5 tiers (S through D) with pastel colors (red -> orange -> yellow -> light yellow -> green). ### Style (`src/App.tsx`) ```typescript interface Style { ratio: string; // "preserve" | "fit" | "stretch" size: number; // pixel size of images (default 80) quality: number; // JPEG compression 1-100 (default 100) pasteScaleMode: "fixed" | "preserve"; // whether pasted images get scaled } ``` ### ImageItem (in Tier.tsx, ImageHolder.tsx) ```typescript interface ImageItem { id: number; url: string; // data URL (may be downscaled preview or full-res) text?: string; // user-editable caption } ``` ### OriginalImageItem (imageStore.ts) ```typescript interface OriginalImageItem { id: number; url: string; // always full-resolution data URL } ``` ### Project (projectStore.ts) ```typescript interface Project { id: string; // Date.now().toString() name: string; createdAt: number; } ``` --- ## 5. STORAGE ARCHITECTURE (DUAL SYSTEM) This is one of the most complex parts of the app. ### IndexedDB (`imageStore.ts`) - **Database**: `"dynamic-tier-list"`, version 1, single object store `"images"` - **Key format**: `{namespace}_{logicalKey}` where namespace = `project__` - **Logical keys**: - `imageHolder` -- stores array of `ImageItem` for the unassigned image pool - `tierImages_{tierId}` -- stores array of `ImageItem` for each tier - `originalImage_{imageId}` -- stores a single string (full-res data URL) per image - **Pattern**: Images are rendered as **downscaled previews** (resized to `size * devicePixelRatio`), but the original full-resolution data URL is preserved separately in the `originalImage_` keys. On save, previews are swapped back to full-res via `getFullResolutionImages()`, then persisted. - **Migration system**: - V1 flag (`imageStoreMigratedV1`): moved images from localStorage to IndexedDB - V2 flag (`projectMigrationV2`): copies un-namespaced IndexedDB keys into project-namespaced keys - Both migrations run once, guard with localStorage flags ### localStorage (`projectStore.ts` + App.tsx) - `projectList` -- JSON array of `Project` objects - `currentProjectId` -- string - `project_{id}_tiers` -- JSON array of `Tier` objects - `project_{id}_style` -- JSON `Style` object - App handles migration of old formats (e.g., when `style` was just a ratio string, when tiers used `id` as the label) --- ## 6. RENDERING LOGIC ### Tier List Layout - The `TierList` component wraps all `Tier` rows in a **ReactSortable** (vertical sortable). Users can drag entire tier rows to reorder them. - Each `Tier` row is a horizontal flex container with: - Left side: colored label box (width = `size * 1.2`, minHeight = `size`px). This has the `.handle` class for SortableJS grip. - Right side: another **ReactSortable** with `group="shared"` -- this is crucial: all tiers share the same sortable group, so images can be **dragged between tiers**. - Right-clicking a tier label opens a context menu with: SketchPicker color editor, tier label text input, and delete tier button. ### Image Rendering - Each `Image` is `` with: - CSS class based on `style.ratio` (`.preserve` for natural aspect, `.fit` for `object-fit: cover`, `.stretch` for `object-fit: fill`) - Fixed width/height of `style.size`px - Lazy loading and async decoding - Hover shows a red X delete button (top-right corner) - If `image.text` is non-empty, a semi-transparent caption bar is overlaid at the bottom - Right-click menu: "Edit Text" (opens modal with textarea) and "Delete Image" - `React.memo` wraps the Image component for performance ### ImageHolder (Unassigned Pool) - Bottom area that acts as an "inbox" for images not yet placed in tiers - Same ReactSortable with `group="shared"` -- images flow freely between ImageHolder and any tier - Shows instructional text when empty - Gear icon button opens SettingsModal ### Image Import Two methods, both handled in `ImageHolder`: 1. **Drag and drop**: Native `drag`/`drop` events on `document`. Files are read via `FileReader.readAsDataURL()`. When dragging FROM the app to outside, a custom `application/x-tier` data type prevents the app from consuming its own drags. 2. **Copy and paste**: Native `paste` event on `document`. Checks `clipboardData.items` for image types, reads them as blobs via `FileReader`. Images are assigned IDs using `Date.now() + index`, stored as original + downscaled preview in IndexedDB. --- ## 7. SETTINGS MODAL (SettingsModal.tsx) Accessible via gear icon on the right side of ImageHolder. Controls: | Setting | Type | Description | |---------|------|-------------| | Aspect Ratio | radio | `preserve` (natural), `1:1 Fit` (cover), `1:1 Stretch` (fill) | | Image Size | number (min 16) | Controls height/width of all images in px | | Compression Quality | range 1-100 | JPEG quality for IndexedDB storage | | Image Scaling | radio | `preserve` original resolution vs `fixed` (scale to current size) | ### Export/Output Actions 1. **Copy Image** -- renders tier list DOM to PNG blob via `html-to-image`, copies to clipboard via `ClipboardItem`. Falls back to save-as-file if blob exceeds a size limit. 2. **Save Image** -- same PNG rendering, triggers browser download. 3. **Clear Project Data** -- removes all localStorage keys with project prefix + clears project's IndexedDB keys, then reloads the page. 4. **Export Full-Res ZIP** -- uses `JSZip` to bundle all original-resolution images organized into tier-named folders, plus `manifest.json` and `manifest.csv`. 5. **Export Spreadsheet (XLSX)** -- uses `exceljs` to create a workbook with one row per tier (tier label in first column, images in subsequent columns with embedded images). Has guardrails: disables embedding if >250 images or >100MB estimated image data; falls back to filename-only cells with a Notes sheet explaining the reason. --- ## 8. PROJECT SELECTOR (ProjectSelector.tsx) - Dropdown showing all projects with CRUD operations - **Create**: inline input, creates a new localStorage entry for the project list - **Rename**: inline editing with Enter/Escape/onBlur - **Delete**: confirmation dialog, then clears both localStorage and IndexedDB for that project, switches to first remaining project if deleting the current one - Switching projects triggers `switchProject(id)` which sets `key={newProjectId}` on `AppInner`, causing a full remount with the new namespace --- ## 9. UNIQUE / NOTABLE FEATURES 1. **Client-only, zero backend** -- all images as data URLs in IndexedDB means no server storage, no sharing. The README explicitly states this is a feature: privacy guarantee for content creators. 2. **Dual-resolution image storage** -- the separation of "preview" (display) and "original" (preserved) image data in IndexedDB means performance stays good even with many images, while export can always access the full original. 3. **Multi-project system with migration** -- three-tier migration (localStorage -> IndexedDB -> project namespacing) handles upgrades gracefully. Old data is never lost; it is migrated into the "Default" project automatically. 4. **Drag between tiers** -- using **SortableJS shared groups**, images can be freely dragged not just within a tier but between any tier row and the unassigned pool. This is the core UX that makes the app "dynamic." 5. **Tier rows are themselves sortable** -- entire tiers can be reordered vertically via a separate ReactSortable with a `.handle` grip. 6. **Multiple export formats** -- PNG screenshot, ZIP with manifest, and embedded-image XLSX spreadsheet. The XLSX export has sophisticated guards (count limit, byte limit) to prevent generating unworkably large files. 7. **Debounced preview refresh** -- when `style.size` changes, image previews are regenerated with a 150ms debounce, listening to both window resize and VisualViewport events (important for mobile zoom). 8. **Context menus throughout** -- right-click on tiers (edit color/name/delete), right-click on images (edit text/delete). Both menus auto-position to stay within viewport bounds. 9. **Caption system** -- every image can have an associated text caption, displayed as a semi-transparent overlay on the image, editable via modal. --- ## 10. FILE SUMMARY TABLE | File | Lines | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | `src/App.tsx` | 219 | Root component, context providers, migration orchestration | | `src/index.tsx` | 20 | ReactDOM entry point | | `src/index.css` | 15 | Tailwind directives + `.preserve`/`.fit`/`.stretch` classes | | `src/components/TierList.tsx` | 42 | Sortable container for tier rows | | `src/components/Tier.tsx` | 305 | Individual tier row: label + sortable images + context menu | | `src/components/TierModal.tsx` | 140 | "Add Tier" button + modal form (color picker + label input) | | `src/components/Image.tsx` | 227 | Image with hover delete, captions, context menu, text modal | | `src/components/ImageHolder.tsx` | 312 | Unassigned image pool: drag/drop + paste + sortable + settings button | | `src/components/ProjectSelector.tsx` | 253 | Project CRUD dropdown | | `src/components/SettingsModal.tsx` | 451 | Settings form + export/copy/save/clear actions | | `src/utils/imageStore.ts` | 353 | IndexedDB CRUD, image resizing, migration logic | | `src/utils/projectStore.ts` | 79 | Project list localStorage CRUD | | `src/utils/exportUtils.ts` | 451 | ZIP export, XLSX export, manifest collection |
